notes.title: Secret Gems + New Skins!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 2[/h1]

With the oncoming year, we thought Korlax could use some more challenges! So take on this quest to find these [b]4 Hidden Gems.[/b] Only the most daring adventurers may succeed!

[h2]Additions:[/h2]  

- 4 Secret Gems Hidden in [b]New[/b] rooms.

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]  

- Skins rotate correctly for Start Cutscene.
- Keybind Issues Fixed.
- Boss Level rotation Issues Fixed.
- Upgrade auto-equip fixed on Boss Level.
- Enemies on last level position fixed.


Good Luck Korlaxians!

notes.title: Patch 01 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 01 - Bug Fixes[/h1]

With many issues regarding Skins, Achievements, Cutscene Skipping - I've spent time fixing and testing so that the community can continue to challenge themselves!

Any other major bugs or issues, please reach out through the Community Hub! 🚀


[h2]Fixes[/h2]

- Cutscenes have approx. 5 second wait before you can skip

- Skins and Achievements should now all be unlockable

- Upgrades when purchased Automatically assign

- added text to Skin Unlocked icon - "At Main Menu"
